About

Who's
behind this

Journalism student, community manager and builder.

22 · Temuco, Chile

I'm Pau, I'm 22 and I study Journalism at Universidad Autónoma de Chile. I've been coding for 4 years and I'm interested in where journalism and tech meet.

What I like about journalism is translating the complex: so someone with no technical background understands what's happening and why it matters to them. Since 2022 I've run the Tellus Cooperative community, I co-organize Stellar Chile and I founded Nurea.

Tech journalism · Digital communications · Community · Culture: video games and film · Research

Featured project

Featured
project

How I designed Loot, from brand to interface.

BRAND AND PRODUCT DESIGN · STELLAR MAINNET

Loot

Puzzle chests with real prizes where bots can't steal the answer. My challenge: make anyone understand why, without knowing what a zero-knowledge proof is.

IdentityDesktop and mobile UIPitch deckWeb
Visit findloot.xyz
  1. 01

    Why I picked it

    Because it brings together everything I do: designing, building and explaining tech so people get it.

  2. 02

    Goal and audience

    Crypto communities that create puzzles and players who solve them. Show that the prize is safe from bots.

  3. 03

    How I built it

    Identity (the chest), design system, desktop and mobile screens, and a pitch deck to present it.

  4. 04

    Challenge and solution

    ZK is invisible. I solved it by showing the contrast: a normal chest marked “STOLEN” next to a ChestZK one marked “SAFE”.

  5. 05

    What I learned and what I'd improve

    That designing is also explaining. I'd test the interface with more non-technical people before launching.
